text:
cheng: Quick kickoff — creating new org 'edge-eu' for EU edge capacity. Goal: serve low-latency inference in eu-central1 + eu-west1. Need GPU quota increases (A100/40GB or equivalent), reserved static IP pool for inference endpoints, IAM baseline, billing link, and tags. Target go-live: 3 weeks.
leah: ack. can you put expected capacity numbers? how many GPUs per region and any burst pattern?
cheng: initial steady req: 8 GPUs eu-central1, 6 GPUs eu-west1 (A100/40GB equiv). Burst pool: +6 GPUs across regions for peak. We'll run mixed workloads (short chat + embeddings) so concurrency matters.
mike_infra: checklist I usually follow: enable APIs, create billing account linkage, create project under org (edge-eu-prod), provision service account + roles, open quota cases for each cloud + region, reserve static IPs and request LB forwarding-rule quotas, request VPC subnet IP increase if > /20, prepare tags and billing tags. posting runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/cross-cloud-provisioning (see 'edge' section).
samir: firewall/nat notes: if we expose endpoints, we need 50 static IPs? what's the expected number of endpoints vs worker egress IPs. Also watch egress quotas in eu regions — raised before.
cheng: we expect 12 endpoint IPs (ingress) and ~30 egress NAT IPs across availability zones for outbound to model registries and observability. Reserve 40 to be safe.
mike_infra: for AWS: open Support case to increase EC2 On-Demand limits for p4d and p3dn in eu-west-1 and eu-central-1. For GCP: request GPUs (a2/a100) per region via support console and ensure 'Compute Engine API' + 'Service Networking' enabled. For Azure: request NCas v4 quotas if we need.
leah: sample commands to add to runbook for infra automation?
mike_infra: yes, add snippets. GCP create project + set IAM:
```
gcloud projects create edge-eu-prod --name="edge-eu-prod" --organization=1234567890
billing accounts link: gcloud beta billing projects link edge-eu-prod --billing-account=0000-AAAA-BBBB
```
AWS create role example (short):
```
aws iam create-role --role-name RedwoodEdgeServiceRole --assume-role-policy-document file://trust.json
```
Also include quota request template text to paste into support forms.
cheng: cost estimate for steady capacity: roughly 8 A100s + 6 A100s => ~14 GPUs -> ~ $85k/month if on-demand (ballpark). We'll refine with dedicated vs reserved. Put cost owner in billing ticket.
sam_r: (typo note) I'm samir, small ask: can we pin placement groups / AZ preferences? some regions collapse GPUs quickly — prefer mixed AZ spread.
leah: tagging policy: required tags = [team:redwood-inference, project:edge-eu, cost-center:edge-2026, env:prod]. Add 'sensitive:yes' only for private datasets.
mike_infra: network quotas to request: 
- GCP: static external IP quota 40 in both regions, forwarding-rules 50, routes 1000;
- AWS: Elastic IP quotas (increase to 40), ENI limits, NAT gateway rate / throughput increase if needed;
- Azure: Public IP increase and load balancer rules.
cheng: timeline & owners:
- Week 0 (this week): create org/project, link billing — owner: leah
- Week 1: open quota cases for GCP/AWS/Azure — owner: mike_infra
- Week 1-2: reserve static IPs and VPC setup + subnets — owner: samir
- Week 2: infra automation (terraform) and IAM policies — owner: leah
- Week 3: smoke test with 2 GPUs, then scale to steady — owner: cheng
leah: I'll create the billing ticket and drop IDs here.
ops-bot: GCP support case created: Case 1234567890 — request: GPUs in eu-central1/eu-west1, static IPs 40 each region. ETA: 3-5 business days.
mike_infra: AWS case opened: Ticket #AWS-987654 — request p4/p3 limits increase in eu-west-1 + eu-central-1. Expect outreach from AWS AM.
samir: quick question on quotas: do we want to request soft reservations or just quota increases? reserved capacity (Dedicated) on Redwood Dedicated can be cheaper/guaranteed — should we start procurement parallel?
cheng: yes — open Dedicated inquiry with sales but still request on-demand quotas as fallback.
leah: putting checklist in shared doc and will create PR for terraform templates. link to doc: https://redwood.internal/doc/edge-eu-onboard (will update).
mike_infra: minor gotcha — some regions throttle GPU quotas by project and by user. If support asks for justification, mention: low-latency inference for customers in EU, expected token throughput X/day, permanent need for 14 GPUs (list job types).
cheng: noted. Any blockers now?
samir: can you add network egress cost estimate? NAT egress could be 20-30TB/month. That'll impact billing.
cheng: will add conservative 30TB egress to cost estimate.
leah: okay creating tasks in GH issues and assigning. I'll post the IDs when done. :thumbsup:
mike_infra: added automation snippets to runbook and a quota request template. Dropping here for copy/paste:
```
GCP quota request text:
We are provisioning a new production project 'edge-eu-prod' under Redwood Inference org for low-latency LLM inference. Requested quotas: 40 static external IPs, X GPUs (list per region), 50 forwarding rules. Justification: Production inference endpoints for EU customers, traffic estimates attached.
```
ops-bot: AWS support reply received: AWS-987654 updated — they requested expected sustained vs burst GPU hours. Please add numbers to ticket.
cheng: will fill AWS ticket today with sustained 14 GPUs steady ~720 hours/month (per-GPU) and burst 6 GPUs for 120 hours.
leah: thanks — keep this thread updated with support IDs and final PR links.
cheng: thanks team — I'll call out follow-ups in calendar invite for Monday standup."
